teacher: 16D random orthogonal embedding of8 signal and8 nuisance coordinates. Four disjoint signal-coordinate products. Native training nuisance nearly duplicates signals; test breaks that correlation. Teacher factors/axes never supplied to optimizer. Student has4 bilinear products: known true rank is an explicit architectural prior.
objectives: native MSE; endpoints: half native+intervened endpoint MSE; effects: native MSE + finite-effect MSE; shuffled: native MSE + permuted finite-effect targets. All same optimizer/steps/batches/initializations. Output weight penalty1e-5; normalized factors. No reconstruction objective or convex-hull constraint.
limits: Synthetic mechanism probe, not LLM evidence. Effect/native losses use same teacher-output variance normalization; objectives differ and endpointbaseline sees same endpoint data. No claim losses are equivalent or architecture general.
